newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip, players sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip, players sidelined.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker across the board on Wednesday after drifting in tight ranges, traders said, adding that volume was light.
Most market players retreated to the sidelines in the abbreviated week due to Japan's "Golden Week" holiday.
Prices ranged from 0.9 yen to 2.9 yen per kg lower, with benchmark October ending down 0.9 yen at 138.0 yen.
"There were no factors to affect the market today. Private investors tended to sell rubber futures on any price rebound," one trader said.
